intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.9.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 25.87ms pinned cold boot -95.6%, 57.6 KB gzip shell, 16.68 MB RSS -85.5% vs v1.2.0, 1-Click Playtest Failure -> Targeted Luau Auto-Fix Plan + Apply & Re-Run, wrapped Code Workbench toolbar, Monetization Tier Presets & 48h Comeback Retention Curve, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 7,087 req/s 16w pinned with 3.00ms p95), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.7.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with Board Quick-Filter chips & 1-click Wave Digest, #seq Quote-Reply & ? cheatsheet, clean Screenshot caption chips, worker duration pills & inline nudge bar, and build-time index.html.gz + --jitless V8 diet giving 336.3 KB raw / 99.9 KB gz, 37.8ms boot -37.6%, 80.98 MB RSS -15.2%, 2,853 req/s +20.0%, 8.49ms p95, and 22/22 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.18.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 9.31 MB binary -20.9% / -41.8% vs v0.10.0, 22.14 MB RSS -15.5% / -57.6% vs v0.11.0, Citation Freshness Pre-Flight Gate & 1-Click Verified Client Handoff .html + SHA-256 manifest, 1-Click Run/Receipt Comparison & Delta Packs .md, Unified Fuzzy Cmd+K jump, clickable [file:L##] Source Inspector, and 1,802 req/s 16w pinned).
